narrative.text: Merchant MID101884 declared subscription_box at onboarding 103 days ago. Telemetry dissents: the largest deviations from the subscription_box baseline are chargeback_rate at +2.8 sigma (observed 0.0104 against a category baseline of 0.00425), slope_log_volume at -2.8 sigma (observed -0.00213 against a category baseline of 0.00262), chargeback_drift at +2.8 sigma (observed 0.00551 against a category baseline of -8e-05). The checkout surface is consistent with the declared subscription_box category (0.90 confidence). In total 1 independent view of this merchant contradict its declaration. The investigation used 4 of a permitted 8 steps and stopped because evidence exhausted. Recommended tier is analyst review with settlements continuing, because only one view dissents.
